paite: Huailouin Toupan Job a dawnga, hichiin a chi a:
english: Moreover Yahweh answered Job,

paite: Kuapeuh awlmoh neilou in thil bangkim hihthei a kiselpih diam? Kuapeuh Pathian kiselpih, huai tuh amah dawngsak un.
english: “Shall he who argues contend with the Almighty? He who argues with God, let him answer it.”

paite: Huan Jobin Toupa a dawnga, hichiin a chi a.:
english: Then Job answered Yahweh,

paite: Ngaiin, Bangmah ka hi keia; bang ka hon dawng dia? Ka kam ah ka khut ka koih.
english: “Behold, I am of small account. What shall I answer you? I lay my hand on my mouth.

paite: Khatvei ka pauta a, ka dawng kei ding; ahi nihvei, himahleh ka pau nawn kei ding.
english: I have spoken once, and I will not answer; Yes, twice, but I will proceed no further.”

paite: Huchiin Toupan Job pingpei akipanin a dawnga, hichiin a chi a:
english: Then Yahweh answered Job out of the whirlwind,

paite: Ki pasal sakin tuin na kawng gak in: nang akipan ka honphut dia, kei kiangah na honphuang ding hi.
english: “Now brace yourself like a man. I will question you, and you will answer me.

paite: Ka vaihawmna nangawn bangmahloua koih ding na hi hia? Siam na tantheihna dia, kei honmohpaih ding na hi hia?
english: Will you even annul my judgment? Will you condemn me, that you may be justified?

paite: Ahihkeileh Pathian bangin ban na nei hia? Huan amah bangin awin vanpi na gingsak thei hia?
english: Or do you have an arm like God? Can you thunder with a voice like him?

paite: Tuin nang hoihkim leh zahnain kijem in; zahna leh lalnain kivan in.
english: “Now deck yourself with excellency and dignity. Array yourself with honor and majesty.

paite: Na hehna dimlette sungkhia in; huan mi chih kisatheite en inla, hihniam in.
english: Pour out the fury of your anger. Look at everyone who is proud, and bring him low.

paite: Mi chih kisathei en inla, kainiam in; huan a dinna uah migiloute tuanchil in.
english: Look at everyone who is proud, and humble him. Crush the wicked in their place.

paite: Leivui ah amaute selkhawm in; mun daiah a mai uh kan in.
english: Hide them in the dust together. Bind their faces in the hidden place.

paite: Huchiin na khut taklamin nang a hondam thei chih ka honthei ding.
english: Then I will also admit to you that your own right hand can save you.

paite: Nang kon siam banga ka siam, tuin en in chingpi; bawngtal bangin loupa a ne.
english: “See now, behemoth, which I made as well as you. He eats grass as an ox.

paite: En in tuin, a hatna a kawngah a oma, a gilpi thate ah a hatna a om hi.
english: Look now, his strength is in his thighs. His force is in the muscles of his belly.

paite: Sidar sing bangin a mei a tangsaka: a pheite thaguite phankhawmin a om hi.
english: He moves his tail like a cedar. The sinews of his thighs are knit together.

paite: A guhte dal lawng ahi uh; a guh leh tangte sik tawn bang ahi.
english: His bones are like tubes of brass. His limbs are like bars of iron.

paite: Pathian lampitea a pipen ahi: amah bawlpa kiain a namsau amah kiang lam naih dingin a bawl thei ding.
english: He is the chief of the ways of God. He who made him gives him his sword.

paite: Chihtaktakin mualten an amah a puak ua; gamsate tengteng mawlna munah.
english: Surely the mountains produce food for him, where all the animals of the field play.

paite: Tuilili singte nuaiah a luma, pumpeng mun dai leh gam nawng ah.
english: He lies under the lotus trees, in the covert of the reed, and the marsh.

paite: Tuilili singten amah a limun a khuh ua; luite singnahkaiten amah a tuam kimvel vek.
english: The lotuses cover him with their shade. The willows of the brook surround him.

paite: Ngaiin, lui a dimlet leh, a ling kei: a kam chiang pha hialin Jordan khang mahleh, a muang hi.A kiven laiin kuapeuhin amah sikkawiin a man diam, ahihkeileh thangin a nak a vut pailet diam?
english: Behold, if a river overflows, he doesn’t tremble. He is confident, though the Jordan swells even to his mouth.

paite: A kiven laiin kuapeuhin amah sikkawiin a man diam, ahihkeileh thangin a nak a vut pailet diam?
english: Shall any take him when he is on the watch, or pierce through his nose with a snare?
